stable.label: matter-lab-0.6-integrated
stable.note: Matter Lab 0.6 is integrated after a fully green pull-request CI run. Overall product remains unverified because the live GitHub.io deployment and real iPhone Safari have not been independently exercised.

ci.simulation_test: PASS genesis matter 0.6 cooperative self-assembly tests

capabilities: reversible association between unlike generic species
explicit forward and reverse toy reaction events
internal transformed particle state on reacted associations
tagged cooperative and closure assembly edges

active_objective: Turn coarse cooperative self-assembly into an inspectable compartment precursor: detect closed spatial loops, estimate enclosed regions, and distinguish mere graph cycles from persistent enclosure without claiming a membrane or cell.
next_gate: Add a compartment-precursor detector on an isolated Lab branch, preserve the 0.6 assembly and regression fixtures, and require independent CI before promotion.
invariants: ChatGPT cannot self-certify its own changes
No critical project fact may live only in chat memory
Prototype experiments do not become product without a productionization gate
Tyler is not the build system or log courier
UNKNOWN must never silently become PASS
Infrastructure must not be described as simulation capability
CI PASS does not imply live deployment PASS or iPhone PASS
Toy reaction events must not be described as validated chemistry
Toy topology valence limits must not be described as chemical valence
Toy assembly bias must not be described as validated membrane self-assembly
Particle state transformation must conserve particle count
